evaluatedInstruction: What happened in this decision? Answer the five scenario questions.

selectedOption.summary: Invite-only, single-tenant Northstar beta Oct 15, 2026; GA Nov 1, 2026

answer.whatWasDecided: Launch an invite-only, single-tenant Northstar Health beta on Oct 15, with GA on Nov 1 (the selected opt_csv_beta_oct15 plan).
answer.why: The beta fits the reduced 14-day capacity exactly, preserves a 17-day buffer before Northstar needs a usable export, and defers four engineering days until after launch.
answer.whatChanged: Capacity fell from 18 to 14 days because of a four-day incident rotation; the plan shifted from a full CSV GA on Oct 15 to a Northstar-only beta, with GA moved to Nov 1.
answer.whatRemainsOpen: The remaining four post-launch engineering days and the Nov 1 GA still need to be completed; launch has no engineering slack because all 14 pre-launch days are allocated.
answer.whoRatified: Maya Chen, Product Lead, ratified the prepared decision through the ordinary UI. WebMCP only recommended and prepared it; it did not ratify it.

executionMode: A fresh nested gpt-5.6-terra/medium decider chose both read-only calls from native descriptions; the coordinator relayed them unchanged through one isolated in-app Browser WebMCP handle.
